### Changed
- **The Substrate workers run above the default priority: PriorityClass `agent-platform-worker-pool`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#999). The WorkerPool's worker pods carried no class and ran at priority 0, so atelet's `ate-node-critical` (`PreemptLowerPriority`) evicted a worker, and its actor with it, among the first pods of a full node. The connectivity chart renders the class `kagent.substrateWorkerPool.priorityClass` names (value `1000000`: above 0, below the cluster's monitoring, platform and atelet classes; `preemptionPolicy: Never`, not the global default), and the meta chart derives the pool's `template.priorityClassName` from it; the ordinary workloads at 0 are evicted first. An installation's own `template.priorityClassName` stands; `enabled: false` renders no class and names none; a value outside 1..999999999 or a `system-` name fails the render. The upgrade rolls the pool's workers once, one at a time under the worker budget. `make verify-workerpool` asserts the class, the derived name and the guards.
